draft.title: Does predicting the next word tell us much about reasoning?
draft.body:
I came across a January 2025 user report with a very small DeepSeek R1 test. It measured perplexity: roughly, how well a model predicts the text that comes next. But the test didn't give the model a chance to work through an answer step by step.

That left me wondering how much this kind of score tells us about solving actual problems. The sample was tiny, so I wouldn't use it to pick a model on its own.

What would be a simple follow-up test to check reasoning, rather than just text prediction?

Information value is good due to the framing of the problem and the actionable question.
